what: One worked settings object and one worked language pack, with what both readers must make of them. The banner's suite asserts against this file; the tag's tests.yaml carries the same values by hand. Nothing can span the two - only the tag manager runs the second one - so this file is what stands in for a shared test.

language.note: A published pack, cut down to what this fixture asserts. The shape is the emitted <locale>.json exactly: words under texts, the four categories keyed under consents.

buttonSave.note: The pack says nothing about it, so the banner keeps its English and the tag sends nothing at all. A missing key is a fallback; a blank one would not be.

policyUrl.note: The pack's address wins over the settings, because a Greek site links a Greek policy page.
